items.summary: Varroc Engineering has announced a joint venture with Forsee Power to develop battery-pack solutions for electric vehicles. The collaboration will begin with battery packs for three-wheelers, with plans to expand into other vehicle segments. Varroc will acquire a 45 percent stake in Forsee Power’s Indian subsidiary. This venture aims to combine expertise in battery technology and manufacturing for scalable solutions.

items.summary: Biocon announced a settlement with Genentech over its biosimilar, Pebrilzo, of the cancer drug Perjeta. The agreement allows Biocon to launch Pebrilzo in early 2027 in the UK and EU, and in late 2028 in the US. In response to Genentech's patent infringement suit, the New Jersey court dismissed the case at Genentech's request. The details of the settlement agreement remain confidential between the companies involved.

items.summary:
Indian Bank on Thursday reported a 15 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 3,462 crore for the second quarter ended September 30.
The Chennai-based public sector lender posted a net profit of Rs 3,018 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal.
Its total income increased to Rs 23,059 crore in the second quarter from Rs 19,077 crore a year ago, Indian Bank said in a regulatory filing.
Interest income rose to Rs 19,106 crore in the September quarter of FY27 from Rs 16,590 crore in the year-ago period.
The operating profit also increased to Rs 7,090 crore against Rs 4,837 crore in the same quarter a year ago.
